prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering onboarding flows can yield major wins (+12.0%, +3.1%), but can also severely backfire (-8.9%), with positive impacts often overestimated.
Account safety copy changes during sign-in were helpful (+3.5%), whereas general intro copy updates showed no clear effect.
UI redesigns and guides carry high risk, hurting performance far worse than predicted (-10.1% vs -1.0%), while other redesigns showed no clear effect.
Notifications, waiting screens, hints, and checklist layout changes showed no clear effect, making positive predictions (+0.5% to +5.0%) consistently too high.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, hint: +1.8% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: -4.1% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: +0.2% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, reorder: +3.1% over 1 test(s)
- finish, layout: -5.6% over 1 test(s)
- finish, redesign: -10.1% over 1 test(s)
- home, notification: -1.3% over 2 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +0.3% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, copy: +3.5% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +1.5% over 2 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 78.3%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 83.4%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 21.0%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Preset Pet Archetype Selection Gallery: Redesign the pick_friend screen with a structured grid layout featuring clear pet personality archetypes and companion preview cards. (why: The adoption step has a low conversion rate of 60.9% and a median time of 89s, indicating drop-off and friction during companion selection.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign-In Screen to Final Onboarding Step: Move the sign_in step to occur right after waiting and before the final home_intro screen. (why: Moving sign-in after users have already chosen and customized their pet reduces early drop-off and helps link their newly created pet directly to their account.)
2: [sign_in, copy] Existing Account Pet Recovery Sign-In Copy: Update sign-in headline and body copy to explicitly reassure users that signing in safeguards and restores their existing pets. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing pets or resets after re-authenticating, and past findings show account safety copy during sign-in improves conversion (+3.5%).)
3: [adoption, layout] Adoption Certificate Stage Layout: Change adoption_certificate layout to 'stage' to create a focused celebration moment before desktop asset rendering. (why: Adoption step has the lowest conversion rate in the funnel (60.9%) and long completion times.)
4: [finish, copy] Desktop Pet Launch Button Copy: Update the home_intro headline and primary call-to-action button label to explicitly prompt releasing the pet onto the desktop. (why: The finish step has a drop-off rate of 35.2% (64.8% conversion) and median duration of 395s, showing hesitation at the final step.)
5: [home, wait_info] Asset Generation Progress & Time Indicator: Enable progress bar and estimated time indicators on the waiting screen during pet rendering. (why: The waiting step has a high median time (201s) and mean time (2336s), causing user impatience and drop-off without visual feedback.)
